config.metric: short-path traffic fraction = share of last 200 branch commitments choosing the short branch; steady = mean of trailing 200-tick window, per seed

verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 asymmetric (Ll=2Ls): short-path traffic fraction > 0.8 at steady state in >= 80% of seeds

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 symmetric (Ll=Ls): symmetry breaks — one path wins (final > 0.8 or < 0.2) in >= 80% of seeds, winner seed-dependent

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 self-reinforcement: cross-seed mean short fraction non-decreasing over the run (tol 0.05) and final >= 0.8
